'''Carlitina Semla''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] who worked for the pharmaceutical company [[Culpharm]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Semla was the head of [[Culpharm Security]] and lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]], where Culpharm was based. In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], some of Culpharm's specimen samples went missing, so Semla hired the [[Heroes of Cularin]].<ref name="Mix and Match" />

A short time afterward, Semla lead a Culpharm Security team in an attack on the [[Genasys]] Security Division, outside the shop [[Natural]], in [[Gadrin]]. [[Genasys]] was a rival company of Culpharm and Semla had been tasked with preventing Genasys from making a deal with the [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[biochemist]] [[Higgie Sethven]].<ref name="Find the Lady">{{LivingForce|Trade Wars: Find the Lady}}</ref>
